methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Growing workforce pressure in Richmond signals emerging demand for deep AI skills outside NoVA, but success depends on whether training infrastructure can convert pressure into distributed capability or merely concentrate anxiety.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-funded community-driven training in Southwest Virginia represents infrastructure for distributed deep learning, testing whether peer networks and local institutions can build AI fluency in historically underserved regions facing economic transition.

signals.title: Norfolk Southern deploys AI system to catch wheel defects before they break - The Business Journals
signals.signal_reading: Norfolk Southern's deployment of turnkey AI defect detection exemplifies shallow-but-functional platform adoption in industrial contexts—distributed geographically but not building local capability to develop or modify the systems.

signals.title: Pentagon Expands Scale AI Deal to $500M and AI Defense Firm TurbineOne Moves HQ to Northern Virginia - Clearance Jobs
signals.signal_reading: Pentagon's $500M Scale AI expansion and TurbineOne HQ relocation to NoVA reinforces the defense-AI concentration dynamic, deepening metro capability clusters while offering no distribution mechanism to other Virginia regions.

signals.title: Roanoke College president: Virginia’s future workforce depends on fixing the path from college to career - Cardinal News
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College president's warning about broken college-to-career pathways signals the gap scenario risk: recognition of workforce needs without the infrastructure to build either deep skills or broad platform access outside metro areas.
